body:
## What's Changed
* chore(deps): bump rustls to 0.23.45 by @anthoturc in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15667
* docs: fix stale chart and workflow paths by @ZainnQureshii in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15682
* build(deps-dev): bump jest from 30.4.2 to 30.5.2 in /web/app by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15651
* build(deps-dev): bump css-loader from 7.1.4 to 7.1.5 in /web/app by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15653
* build(deps): bump helm.sh/helm/v3 from 3.21.4 to 3.22.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15655
* build(deps): bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.70.1 to 0.71.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15656
* build(deps): bump github.com/mattn/go-runewidth from 0.0.29 to 0.0.30 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15657
* build(deps): bump tokio-metrics from 0.5.1 to 0.5.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15660
* build(deps): bump prometheus-client-derive-encode from 0.5.0 to 0.5.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15662
* build(deps): bump smallvec from 1.15.2 to 1.16.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15661
* build(deps): bump zerocopy from 0.8.56 to 0.8.59 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15659
* build(deps): bump codecov/codecov-action from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15669
* build(deps): bump docker/setup-buildx-action from 4.3.0 to 4.4.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15672
* build(deps): bump docker/build-push-action from 7.3.0 to 7.4.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15673
* build(deps): bump docker/setup-qemu-action from 4.3.0 to 4.4.0 in /.github/actions/docker-build by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15675
* build(deps-dev): bump webpack-bundle-analyzer from 5.3.2 to 5.4.0 in /web/app by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15678
* build(deps-dev): bump @babel/runtime from 8.0.0 to 8.0.5 in /web/app by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15679
* build(deps): bump the pest group across 1 directory with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15658
* build(deps): bump webpack-dev-middleware from 7.4.2 to 7.4.6 in /web/app by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15685
* build(deps): bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.83.2 to 1.84.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15680
* build(deps): bump docker/setup-buildx-action from 4.3.0 to 4.4.1 in /.github/actions/docker-build by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15674
* build(deps): bump the kube group across 1 directory with 7 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15683
* build(deps-dev): bump webpack from 5.110.3 to 5.111.1 in /web/app by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15677
* build(deps): bump clap_lex from 1.1.0 to 1.1.1 in the clap group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15686
* Update PR template to point to discussions by @kflynn in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15696
* proxy: v2.370.0 by @l5d-bot in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15681

## New Contributors
* @ZainnQureshii made their first contribution in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15682

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/compare/edge-26.9.3...edge-26.10.1
